title: Vehicle Skinning Guides
description: Contains UV outlines, UV wireframes and a cleanish white body background for each of the current official cars to aid in creating custom liveries/paintjobs for the cars. Useful for Photoshop or your favourite image editing tool to create layer guides.

title: Decal Groups Tool
description: This tool allows you to manage your Wreckfest 2 CRAP-IT decal groups. Import, export, delete, rename, label previews, replace preview image and create custom mod decals.
